summary: Publish the money and town-transaction types (denominations, per-province coin ledger, transaction/exchange shapes) that Lane X's later increments build on

coordination.notes: No existing module owns money/currency types - grep for coin/wealth/silver/platinum/bronze/copper across src/lib and src/data found none. Reuses (does not fork) the existing Province type from src/data/obstacles.ts for the per-province bank ledger, and the existing account-tier bank-cap logic in src/lib/accountCapabilities.ts and src/data/townRun.ts is left untouched - this file is the coin/currency data model, not a second town-run planner. Deliberately does NOT add a field to CharacterStatus in src/types/index.ts: the conflict matrix (PLAN_TO_1_0.md section 3) locks CharacterStatus to W0 until W0 is [x], and W0 is still unclaimed/unmerged as of this claim. src/types/index.ts is touched only via a barrel re-export of the new townLoop.ts types, following the existing `export type { SkillState }` / `export type { CharacterProfile }` pattern already in that file - no CharacterStatus edit. docs/BRIDGE_CONTRACT.md gets an additive new subsection documenting the type as published-but-not-yet-wired (DRCM is the Lich API that will drive it, per docs/DOMAIN.md section 11); nothing in the existing contract sections was rewritten.
